title: GP Attraction Content Governance Framework
purpose: Govern all GP attraction content so doctors receive honest practice-experience information — not recruitment-agency marketing.
appliesTo: Join Our Team / GP Opportunities / Practice Experience Hub
EOI, Readiness, Session Planner, DPA/19AB Navigator, Practice Support Matrix
Schema, meta titles, OG, alt text, and CTAs on attraction surfaces

forbidden: job board / browse roles / open positions (as primary page framing)
lucrative / top dollar / high income headlines
preferred: commercial terms discussed privately with suitable doctors

forbidden: we issue / approve / guarantee provider numbers
practice determines DPA or s19AB outcomes
guaranteed Medicare billing start date tied to WMC approval
avoidProviderNumberPromises.requiredStatement: Medicare provider numbers are issued by Services Australia. Woolloongabba Medical Centre does not issue, approve or guarantee provider numbers. We can share accurate practice location details to support your application.
preferred: link to PN Readiness / official resources

forbidden: urgency / scarcity tactics (limited spots — act now)
rockstar / passion / family / vibe culture jargon
best workplace / #1 place to work claims
preferred: it may not be the right fit — and that clarity helps

tone.person: We (the practice) speaking to you (the GP)
tone.register: Professional Australian general practice English — plain, specific, non-corporate

pillars.label: Community care
pillars.messaging: Inner-south community general practice; local, team-based care

pillars.label: Continuity of care
pillars.messaging: Patients return to a known GP; relationships over high-volume churn

pillars.label: GP employer brand
pillars.messaging: Honest practice experience: support, systems, boundaries — no marketplace hype

do: Lead with how practice works (day, nursing, sessions, place)
State boundaries explicitly (PN, DPA, commercial privacy, capacity)
dont: Sound like a recruiter or job board
Use empty culture adjectives without systems proof

messaging.primaryFrame: Help doctors decide if Woolloongabba Medical Centre is a fit for how they practise.
messaging.notFrame: Fill vacancies as fast as possible via marketing pressure.
disallowedCtas: Submit your CV to our agency
mustIncludeWhenRelevant: Services Australia issues provider numbers (on PN / eligibility surfaces)
Session availability depends on rooms, nursing cover and practice need
Registrar placements depend on supervisor capacity
Commercial terms are private — no public %

surfaceRoles.gp_opportunities: Decision / fit page — philosophy, facilities, FAQ, soft EOI
surfaceRoles.join_our_team: Practice entry; JobPosting only if live vacancy inject
surfaceRoles.tools: Guidance only — never auto-approve placement or eligibility
surfaceRoles.testimonials: Operational practice stories — not workplace ratings

approvals.principle: No attraction content goes live without a named human approver. Tools and intelligence never auto-publish.

roles.responsibility: Draft against this framework; run self-checklist
Approve operational accuracy (sessions, nursing, capacity, onboarding)
Approve clinical claims, supervision, registrar capacity statements
Approve tone, CTA, photography, testimonial consent, schema

gates.label: Operational truth
checks: Tool links go to current proposals/production URLs

gates.label: Schema + accessibility
checks: Skip link, landmarks, focus, alt, contrast

gates.label: External-agency boundaries
gates.when: PN, DPA, s19AB, visa, or Medicare eligibility mentioned
checks: WMC role limited to assist / locate / orient

changeClasses.examples: New FAQ, Opportunities section, pathway page, pack content
Supervision capacity, registrar intake, clinical interest claims
JobPosting inject, FAQPage graph changes, new WebPage types

approvals.record: Store approver name, date, change class, surface URL, and checklist result with the release note / CMS revision.

allowedOnAttractionSurfaces: FAQPage (only if Q&A visible and text-identical)
Optional VideoObject / Person for consented doctor stories
JobPosting — ONLY on Join Our Team when a live vacancy is injected
forbiddenOnDecisionPages: Occupation aggregates used as hiring bait
JobPosting on GP Opportunities / Practice Experience / pathway pages by default
schemaStandards.faqSyncRule: Visible FAQ question/answer text must match FAQPage JSON-LD acceptedAnswer text exactly.
schemaStandards.breadcrumbDefault: Home → About Us → Join Our Team → [surface]
metaRules: Titles describe practice experience / fit — not ‘GP jobs apply now’ as primary intent when no vacancy
Meta description: no earnings %, no PN guarantees, no agency verbs
OG images: place or consulting stills; no ‘We’re hiring’ burned-in text

accessibilityStandards.baseline: WCAG 2.2 AA intent for attraction surfaces

requirements.rule: Use header, main, nav, contentinfo; single H1 per page
Skip link to #main; main focusable (tabindex=-1) when used as skip target
Visible focus-visible rings; minimum 44×44px touch targets for controls
Body text ≥ 4.5:1 on warm/mist/white; UI chrome meets AA
Prefer native details/summary; do not remove disclosure without aria-expanded equivalent
Descriptive link/button names — Express interest with the practice, not Click here / Apply now
Trust signals (e.g. AGPAL) include text — not colour alone
Meaningful alt for informative images; empty alt for decorative; no text-only-in-image for critical claims
Labels associated; errors tied with aria-describedby + role=alert where used
No essential information in animation only; honour prefers-reduced-motion
Captions/transcripts for doctor or practice videos
lang=en-AU on attraction HTML; plain language over jargon

prePublishChecklist: Hard rules: agency / salary / PN / hype — all clear
Schema allowed for this surface; FAQ synced if present
No secrets or draft intelligence pasted into public HTML
